notes.title: Steam Page translation
notes.content: [p]The game page is now available in new languages![/p][p]We are pleased to announce that we have moved the Steam page to: [/p][list][*][p]Spanish;[/p][/*][*][p]Polish;[/p][/*][*][p]Romanian;[/p][/*][*][p]German;[/p][/*][*][p]Italian;[/p][/*][*][p]French;[/p][/*][*][p]Portuguese;[/p][/*][/list][p]If you have friends or acquaintances who speak these languages, send the game to them! 🎉[/p][p]We would like to remind you that Gatekeeper's Week is currently available only in English and Russian, but we are working towards localization of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for staying with us! Subscribe to our social networks to stay up to date with the latest events and news.[/p][p][url="https://x.com/RiSeBacon" style="button"]X/Twitter[/url] | [url="https://discord.gg/ankeJF9B3k" style="button"]Discord[/url][/p]
